versos.hebraico: וּמִקְנֶ֣ה׀ רַ֗ב הָיָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְלִבְנֵי־גָ֖ד עָצ֣וּם מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת־אֶ֤רֶץ יַעְזֵר֙ וְאֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַמָּק֖וֹם מְק֥וֹם מִקְנֶֽה׃

controles.web: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. When they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for livestock;
controles.kjv: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
controles.livre: E os filhos de Rúben e os filhos de Gade tinham uma muito grande abundância de gado; os quais vendo a terra de Jazer e de Gileade, pareceu-lhes o país lugar de gado.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ בְנֵֽי־גָ֖ד וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
controles.kjv: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
controles.livre: E vieram os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, e falaram a Moisés, e a Eleazar o sacerdote, e aos príncipes da congregação, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: עֲטָר֤וֹת וְדִיבֹן֙ וְיַעְזֵ֣ר וְנִמְרָ֔ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה וּשְׂבָ֥ם וּנְב֖וֹ וּבְעֹֽן׃

controles.web: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
controles.kjv: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
controles.livre: Atarote, e Dibom, e Jazer, e Ninra, e Hesbom, e Eleale, e Sebã, e Nebo, e Beom,

versos.hebraico: הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִפְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֥רֶץ מִקְנֶ֖ה הִ֑וא וְלַֽעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מִקְנֶֽה׃ס

controles.web: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
controles.kjv: Even the country which the Lord smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
controles.livre: A terra que o SENHOR feriu diante da congregação de Israel, é terra de gado, e teus servos têm gado.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אִם־מָצָ֤אנוּ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ יֻתַּ֞ן אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה אַל־תַּעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

controles.web: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
controles.kjv: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
controles.livre: Portanto, disseram, se achamos favor em teus olhos, seja dada esta terra a teus servos em herança, e não nos faças passar o Jordão.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִבְנֵי־גָ֖ד וְלִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן הַאַֽחֵיכֶ֗ם יָבֹ֨אוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם תֵּ֥שְׁבוּ פֹֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to the war, and shall you sit here?
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
controles.livre: E respondeu Moisés aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben: Virão vossos irmãos à guerra, e vós ficareis aqui?

versos.hebraico: וְלָ֣מָּה תנואון אֶת־לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵֽעֲבֹר֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?
controles.kjv: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord hath given them?
controles.livre: E por que desencorajais o ânimo dos filhos de Israel, para que não passem à terra que lhes deu o SENHOR?

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּשָׁלְחִ֥י אֹתָ֛ם מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
controles.kjv: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh–barnea to see the land.
controles.livre: Assim fizeram vossos pais, quando os enviei desde Cades-Barneia para que vissem a terra.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲל֞וּ עַד־נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֗וֹל וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּנִ֕יאוּ אֶת־לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְבִלְתִּי־בֹא֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.
controles.kjv: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.
controles.livre: Que subiram até o vale de Escol, e depois que viram a terra, preocuparam o ânimo dos filhos de Israel, para que não viessem à terra que o SENHOR lhes havia dado.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s anger was kindled in that day, and he swore, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord’s anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
controles.livre: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu então, e jurou dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אִם־יִרְא֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הָעֹלִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה אֵ֚ת הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י לֹא־מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרָֽי׃

controles.web: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
controles.kjv: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
controles.livre: Os homens que subiram do Egito de vinte anos acima não verão a terra pela qual jurei a Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, pois não me seguiram por completo;

versos.hebraico: בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן כִּ֥י מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have followed Yahweh completely.’
controles.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.
controles.livre: exceto Calebe, filho do quenezeu Jefoné, e Josué filho de Num, que seguiram por completo ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְנִעֵם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־תֹּם֙ כָּל־הַדּ֔וֹר הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done evil in the sight of Yahweh, was consumed.
controles.kjv: And the Lord’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.
controles.livre: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu em Israel, e os fez andar errantes quarenta anos pelo deserto, até que foi acabada toda aquela geração, que havia feito mal diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֣ה קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים לִסְפּ֣וֹת ע֗וֹד עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף־יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.
controles.kjv: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.
controles.livre: E eis que vós sucedestes em lugar de vossos pais, descendência de homens pecadores, para acrescentar ainda à ira do SENHOR contra Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י תְשׁוּבֻן֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו וְיָסַ֣ף ע֔וֹד לְהַנִּיח֖וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְשִֽׁחַתֶּ֖ם לְכָל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

controles.web: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all of these people.”
controles.kjv: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
controles.livre: Se vos deixardes de segui-lo, ele voltará outra vez a deixar-vos no deserto, e destruireis a todo este povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ וַ֣יֹּאמְר֔וּ גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן נִבְנֶ֥ה לְמִקְנֵ֖נוּ פֹּ֑ה וְעָרִ֖ים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
controles.kjv: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
controles.livre: Então eles se achegaram a ele e disseram: Edificaremos aqui currais para nosso gado, e cidades para nossas crianças;

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם־הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖ם אֶל־מְקוֹמָ֑ם וְיָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֨נוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַמִּבְצָ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
controles.kjv: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
controles.livre: E nós nos armaremos, e iremos com empenho diante dos filhos de Israel, até que os ponhamos em seu lugar: e nossas crianças ficarão em cidades fortes por causa dos moradores do país.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֥א נָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־בָּתֵּ֑ינוּ עַ֗ד הִתְנַחֵל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have each inherited their inheritance.
controles.kjv: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
controles.livre: Não voltaremos a nossas casas até que os filhos de Israel possuam cada um sua herança.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָהָ֑לְאָה כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֨נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ מֵעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃פ

controles.web: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
controles.kjv: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
controles.livre: Porque não tomaremos herança com eles ao outro lado do Jordão nem adiante, porquanto teremos já nossa herança da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִֽם־תַּעֲשׂ֖וּן אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה אִם־תֵּחָֽלְצ֛וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said to them, “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the Lord to war,
controles.livre: Então lhes respondeu Moisés: Se o fizerdes assim, se vos preparardes para ir diante do SENHOR à guerra,

versos.hebraico: וְעָבַ֨ר לָכֶ֧ם כָּל־חָל֛וּץ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛וֹ אֶת־אֹיְבָ֖יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃

controles.web: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
controles.kjv: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the Lord, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
controles.livre: E passardes todos vós armados o Jordão diante do SENHOR, até que tenha expulsado a seus inimigos de diante de si,

versos.hebraico: וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִהְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ים מֵיְהוָ֖ה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠הָיְתָה הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֥את לָכֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless towards Yahweh, and towards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.
controles.livre: E seja o país subjugado diante do SENHOR; logo voltareis, e sereis livres de culpa para com o SENHOR, e para com Israel; e esta terra será vossa em herança diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וּדְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
controles.kjv: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.
controles.livre: Mas se assim não o fizerdes, eis que havereis pecado ao SENHOR; e sabei que vos alcançará vosso pecado.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֽוּ־לָכֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְטַפְּכֶ֔ם וּגְדֵרֹ֖ת לְצֹנַאֲכֶ֑ם וְהַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
controles.kjv: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
controles.livre: Edificai-vos cidades para vossas crianças, e currais para vossas ovelhas, e fazei o que saiu de vossa boca.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בְּנֵי־גָד֙ וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽה׃

controles.web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
controles.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
controles.livre: E falaram os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben a Moisés, dizendo: Teus servos farão como meu senhor mandou.

versos.hebraico: טַפֵּ֣נוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ מִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְכָל־בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑נוּ יִֽהְיוּ־שָׁ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֥י הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

controles.web: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
controles.kjv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
controles.livre: Nossas crianças, nossas mulheres, nossos gados, e todos nossos animais, estarão aí nas cidades de Gileade;

versos.hebraico: וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ כָּל־חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י דֹּבֵֽר׃

controles.web: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”
controles.kjv: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.
controles.livre: E teus servos, armados todos de guerra, passarão diante do SENHOR à guerra, da maneira que meu senhor disse.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֤ו לָהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן וְאֶת־רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
controles.livre: Então os encomendou Moisés a Eleazar o sacerdote, e a Josué filho de Num, e aos príncipes dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִם־יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי־גָ֣ד וּבְנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֣ן׀ אִ֠תְּכֶם אֶֽת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֞ן כָּל־חָל֤וּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle, before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
controles.livre: E disse-lhes Moisés: Se os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, passarem convosco o Jordão, armados todos de guerra diante do SENHOR, logo que o país for subjugado diante de vós, lhes dareis a terra de Gileade em possessão:

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֧א יַֽעַבְר֛וּ חֲלוּצִ֖ים אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְנֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְתֹכְכֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

controles.web: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
controles.kjv: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
controles.livre: Mas se não passarem armados convosco, então terão possessão entre vós na terra de Canaã.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּֽעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי־גָ֛ד וּבְנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.
controles.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the Lord hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben responderam, dizendo: Faremos o que o SENHOR disse a teus servos.

versos.hebraico: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאִתָּ֨נוּ֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָתֵ֔נוּ מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

controles.web: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
controles.kjv: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
controles.livre: Nós passaremos armados diante do SENHOR à terra de Canaã, e a possessão de nossa herança será desta parte do Jordão.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֣ם׀ מֹשֶׁ֡ה לִבְנֵי־גָד֩ וְלִבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְלַחֲצִ֣י׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט׀ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת־מַמְלֶ֨כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֶת־מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן הָאָ֗רֶץ לְעָרֶ֨יהָ֙ בִּגְבֻלֹ֔ת עָרֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
controles.livre: Assim lhes deu Moisés aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben, e à meia tribo de Manassés filho de José, o reino de Seom rei amorreu, e o reino de Ogue rei de Basã, a terra com suas cidades e termos, as cidades do país ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי־גָ֔ד אֶת־דִּיבֹ֖ן וְאֶת־עֲטָרֹ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת עֲרֹעֵֽר׃

controles.web: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
controles.kjv: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
controles.livre: E os filhos de Gade edificaram a Dibom, e a Atarote, e a Aroer,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עַטְרֹ֥ת שׁוֹפָ֛ן וְאֶת־יַעְזֵ֖ר וְיָגְבֳּהָֽה׃

controles.web: Atrothshophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
controles.kjv: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
controles.livre: E a Atarote-Sofã, e a Jazer, e a Jogbeá,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית נִמְרָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית הָרָ֑ן עָרֵ֥י מִבְצָ֖ר וְגִדְרֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃

controles.web: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
controles.kjv: And Beth–nimrah, and Beth–haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
controles.livre: E a Bete-Ninra, e a Bete-Harã: cidades fortificadas, e também currais para ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֤י רְאוּבֵן֙ בָּנ֔וּ אֶת־חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־אֶלְעָלֵ֑א וְאֵ֖ת קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
controles.kjv: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
controles.livre: E os filhos de Rúben edificaram a Hesbom, e a Eleale, e a Quiriataim,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־נְב֞וֹ וְאֶת־בַּ֧עַל מְע֛וֹן מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שֵׁ֖ם וְאֶת־שִׂבְמָ֑ה וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ בְשֵׁמֹ֔ת אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹת הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנֽוּ׃

controles.web: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
controles.kjv: And Nebo, and Baal–meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
controles.livre: E a Nebo, e a Baal-Meom, (mudados os nomes), e a Sibma: e puseram nomes às cidades que edificaram.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה גִּלְעָ֖דָה וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֑הָ וַיּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
controles.kjv: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Maquir filho de Manassés foram a Gileade, e tomaram-na, e expulsaram aos amorreus que estavam nela.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמָכִ֖יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
controles.livre: E Moisés deu Gileade a Maquir filho de Manassés, o qual habitou nela.

versos.hebraico: וְיָאִ֤יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֖ד אֶת־חַוֺּתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִֽיר׃

controles.web: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its towns, and called them Havvoth Jair.
controles.kjv: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth–jair.
controles.livre: Também Jair filho de Manassés foi e tomou suas aldeias, e pôs-lhes por nome Havote-Jair.

versos.hebraico: וְנֹ֣בַח הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד אֶת־קְנָ֖ת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֧א לָ֦ה נֹ֖בַח בִּשְׁמֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
controles.kjv: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
controles.livre: Também Noba foi e tomou a Quenate e suas aldeias, e chamou-lhe Noba, conforme seu nome.
